fishing: WHEN: Sun Nov 1 lingering ENE winds 10-15 kt, moderate chop; sheltered Lemon Bay, passes, protected flats early best. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, flounder, pompano near Stump Pass / Englewood Beach on live shrimp, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: strong redfish, snook, trout, sheepshead on docks, mangroves, oyster bars, flats. NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper / cobia when wind eases. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards (1-3"), soft plastics, weedless gold spoons, popping cork. Sources: FL Sportsman SW (Capt. Greg Stamper Oct 30-Nov 1, windy low water producing redfish/snappers/trout), Fishin Franks / Capt. Mike.
redtide: FWC Oct 30: K. brevis not observed in Southwest Florida past week. Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay and Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota.
bacteria: Charlotte and Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Manasota Key / Englewood Beach / Palm Island / Boca Grande GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2, Sarasota ~149 outages (minor/isolated); no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
